messages:
mia: Stellaris Health sent their RFP this morning. Key asks: EU eu-west-1 private deployment, HSM/FIPS keywrap, 3-week E2E POC with redacted dataset, 200 rps embedding burst, and signed security questionnaire + capability matrix. Need price + one-slide exec risk summary.

raj: Got it. Region confirmed? eu-west-1 only?

mia: They prefer eu-west-1 but said multi-region optional. Primary req is data residency in EU.

claire: I'll take the security questionnaire and capability matrix. Heads up: no FedRAMP; HSM requires 4-6 week onboarding. I'll prefill everything else and annotate the timeline-sensitive fields.

julian: From legal: DPA needs to reference EU data residency and logging retention terms. I'll draft the DPA addendum and ask for their countersign path.

sean: Infrastructure notes: we can stand up a Private control plane in eu-west-1, but HSM integration will be the blocker for day-0 encryption. Short-term mitigation: we can use customer-managed KMS (bring-your-key) as an interim with envelope encryption. Latency SLO: we can aim 95th-pctl <180ms for text-gen at the target sequence length if we use Dedicated small pool + optimized kernels.

mia: Pricing sketch for proposal (ballpark):
```
POC (3w, eng support): $20k flat
Private setup + onboarding (one-time): $10k
Dedicated reserve (1mo small): $28k
Burst license (200 rps embedding): $5.5k/mo
HSM integration professional services (one-time): $14k
```

mia: Can someone build the POC runbook and assign owners? Need network peering, allowlist, test creds, and perf scripts.

raj: I'll own the perf runs and telemetry. Plan: week 0 peer + creds; week 1 synthetic perf baseline; week 2 redacted dataset; week 3 tuning + exec demo.

claire: Uploading sec packet and capability matrix now. I'll flag HSM as "timeline dependent" and include our SOC2 summary and encryption diagrams.

ops-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-rfps/stellaris/stellaris_rfp_packet_v1.zip (owner: claire)

mia: Great. Two asks before I submit: (1) a one-slide risk+mitigation doc for execs; (2) confirm the POC timeline fits their requested 3 weeks.

sean: I'll draft the slide: items: HSM timeline risk + fallback KMS integration, expected latency SLOs, cost summary, and proposed Dedicated+Private approach.

julian: Legal will expedite DPA addendum and provide signing instructions; expecting 2 business days for initial draft.

mia: Thanks all. I'll attach the ZIP to the RFP portal and ping the buyer. Will update thread with confirmation once submitted. :thumbsup:
